game.title: Spyro Reignited Trilogy
game.blurb: 3D platformer collection remaking three late-1990s Spyro games (Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! and Spyro: Year of the Dragon), from Toys for Bob, Iron Galaxy and Activision, released 2018-11-13. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Spyro the Dragon
chapters.summary: Level feats in the first game, from Stone Hill and Dark Hollow to the flight levels, the bosses and Gnasty's Loot.

chapters.title: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!
chapters.summary: Level feats in the second game, from Autumn Plains and Winter Tundra to the speedways, the boss fights and the permanent Super Flame.

chapters.title: Spyro: Year of the Dragon
chapters.summary: Level feats in the third game, including playing as Sheila, Sgt. Byrd, Bentley, Agent 9 and Sparx, the speedways and the bosses.

chapters.title: Hidden Milestones
chapters.summary: Eight hidden achievements, most likely tied to progress through the second and third games. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 996580)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Spyro_Reignited_Trilogy
Fandom (spyro.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://spyro.fandom.com/wiki/Spyro_Reignited_Trilogy
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2018 remake collection, with its own Steam app 996580; the Steam schema calls it "Wasabi" (an internal codename). The three game names come from RAWG's description and the StrategyWiki compilation page. 105 Steam achievements, 8 hidden. Steam API names run ACHIEVEMENT_2 to ACHIEVEMENT_108 with 1, 38 and 68 missing. The split into games is by Steam list order and level names: ACHIEVEMENT_2 to 37 (36 achievements) name first-game levels such as Stone Hill, Dark Hollow, Town Square and Gnasty's Loot; 39 to 67 (29) name second-game places such as Autumn Plains, Winter Tundra, Crush's Dungeon and Ripto's Arena; 71 to 108 use a "Level: task" format and name third-game places and characters (Sunny Villa, Sheila, Sgt. Byrd, Agent 9). The hidden ones (69, 70, 79, 80, 89, 90, 99, 100) come in pairs, one pair every ten numbers, between the end of the second-game block and through the third-game block, so they may be progress milestones, but this is a guess; they have their own chapter. StrategyWiki has "Spyro Reignited Trilogy" at completion stage 1, but it is a compilation page with no subpages of its own; it links the guides for the three originals. "Spyro the Dragon" (completion stage 1) has written level pages (for example Stone Hill, Dark Hollow, Toasty, Gnasty's Loot); "Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!" has Autumn Plains, Summer Forest and Winter Tundra pages; "Spyro: Year of the Dragon" has a Walkthrough page and world pages (Sunrise Springs, Midday Gardens, Evening Lake, Midnight Mountain). Those guides are for the 1998 to 2000 originals, not the remake, so they were not used; they could seed CC BY-SA level notes later if the levels match. spyro.fandom.com answers the API under "Spyro Reignited Trilogy" with about 274 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Many level feats are under 10% on Steam.
